invariants.rationale: Method calls such as containsKey and get will throw a NullPointerException if strategyParams is null.
The schema parameter is passed to HoodieSchemaUtils.addMetadataFields and should not be null.
A Map is either empty or has at least one entry; captures the possible map states.
Maps typically do not have null keys for configuration purposes.
Ensures all map keys used as strategy parameters are non-null, per common usage in config maps.
